title: Tawhid and the Nature of Allah

flashcard_questions.q: The Islamic belief in the absolute oneness of Allah — the most fundamental principle in Islam.
The Islamic declaration of faith: ‘There is no God but Allah, and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.’
The sin of associating partners with Allah or attributing God-like qualities to any other being — the only unforgivable sin in Islam.

flashcard_questions.a: The Shi’a belief in the justice of Allah — that God is perfectly fair and never acts unjustly.
The belief that God is beyond and outside the created universe, existing above and apart from the world.
